Select compounds with exact IC50 values against JAK2 (CHEMBL2971) less than 50 nM and exact IC50 values against JAK1 (CHEMBL2835) greater than 200 nM, using only rows where standard_relation is '=' and standard_units is 'nM'. Compute the compound sets for each target separately and intersect them to ensure each compound appears only once. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return only compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id then canonical_smiles.
